test_title: PYST 3: SSC CGL Tier - II (English) (Held on: 29 Jan 2022)
subject: english
question:
**The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.**

He went / to the bed / with a / slight fever.
solution:
The correct answer is** '​****to the bed'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is grammatically incorrect.
 
• Here, **'to bed' **should be used instead of **'to the bed'.**
 
• **'Go to bed' **obviously means **'go to sleep' **(it doesn't even necessarily have to happen on a bed!) and** 'go to the bed'** just means **'go over to the bed' **and **'sit on it'**. 
 
 
• *​Example: You'd better **go to bed **now.*
 
 
 
• Hence, the correct answer is **Option 3.**

 

**Correct Sentence:__** *He went **to bed **with a slight fever.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **__Hinglish__**

 
• दिया गया वाक्य व्याकरण की दृष्टि से गलत है।
 
• यहां** 'to the bed'** की जगह** 'to bed' **का इस्तेमाल करना चाहिए।
 
• **'Go to bed'** का स्पष्ट रूप से अर्थ है** 'go to sleep'** (यह बिस्तर पर होना भी जरूरी नहीं है!) और **'go to the bed'** का अर्थ है 'बिस्तर पर जाना' और 'उस पर बैठना'।
 
 
• *​Example: You'd better **go to bed **now.*
 
 
 
• अत: सही उत्तर **विकल्प 3** है।
